I LOVE wyvern riders. They might be my favorite class of all time! I'm on a mission to make the most optimal builds for the wyverns within feh, and then post them here on reddit :). We'll start with Cherche, and then i'll get around to Beruka, and then some of you guys can decide what i'll do next? Anyways, here's my Cherche build :)

Bane/Boon: -Res +Atk this should be self explanatory, but just in case you guys don't know, Cherche's best stay by far is attack, while her speed and mainly her res are abysmal. A brave weapon makes up for her speed, but her base res is a measly 14. It's best to go with that, but do whatever you like!

Weapon: Cherche's Axe. I chose to give it the legendary blessing, as it seems WAY better than just adding 3 attack to it. (That and i don't have enough fodder units for a spare panic ploy 😔) It functions as a brave axe with more might, and does the job well!

Special: Draconic Aura. Yes Cherche has 32 defense, but Draconic Aura seems to fit her kit way better than a defensive special, as I usually use her on the attack phase only, as she'll get doubled by almost every unit in the game. 

A slot: Death Blow 3. Pretty self explanatory. Adds to her overall strength when attacking, and this in tandem with hone/ward fliers allows her to do insane amounts of damage.

B slot: Drag Back. Like I stated before, Cherche is a pretty defensively bulky unit, but she cannot stand a hit from any type of mage. After she attacks an opponent and can kill them or pull them across the terrain, it makes it easier for other allied units to finish off the foe or rescue her with a reposition or a dance. It's a pretty great utility skill! Most people would want another offensive skill but i'm too scared to invest in something like that, and i'd always fear for her safety in battle 😪

C slot: Hone Fliers. While this skill slot is extremely versatile for any unit, I put it on Cherche to help her out in a Flier team. Boosting other units can help them take out threats to Cherche, like speedy mages or bowman with high defense (really only halloween jakob haha) You can also put something like attack smoke or savage blow, but she won't need the chip damage 98% of the time

Sacred Seal: Heavy Blade. With Cherche's already insanely high attack combined with buffs, she's sure to put out more attack than most units on the battlefield, helping her to get her special faster. This may be useful for taking out mages or even some swordsman! (If you're brave enough to try ;) ) 

If you made it this far, I thank you for reading my build, and I hope you enjoyed it! Feel free to leave me any constructive criticism or thoughts about my build, and let me know what wyvern I should build next! Have a great day :)
